hero.shahadaEn: Babu abin bautawa da gaskiya sai Allah, kuma Muhammadu manzon Allah ne.
hero.lede: Yi tambaya kuma sami tushen abin da aka ambata kawai - ayah, fassarar, da Tafsir. Ana nakalto kowane sakamako kai tsaye daga maɓuɓɓugan da aka lissafta; babu abin da aka haifar.

facts.title: Haqiqanin Alqur'ani
facts.sub: Tabbatattun bayanai game da Alqurani mai tushe.
facts.disclaimer: Haqiqanin Alqur'ani kawai ya ƙunshi bayanai waɗanda za a iya tantance su kai tsaye daga nassin Alqur'ani ko metadata na Alqur'ani. Ba a haɗa da'awar fassarorin, da'awar mu'ujiza ta kimiyya, da rahotannin da aka yi jayayya ba.
facts.structure.glanceSub: Mahimman ƙididdiga na tsarin Alqur'ani, karantawa kai tsaye daga metadata na Alqur'ani.
facts.structure.hierSub: Yadda aka raba rubutu. Kowane matakin raka'a ne na metadata na tsari - ba naúrar ma'ana ba.
facts.structure.sajdahNote: Ana yin rikodin alamun Sajdah a cikin metadata na tushen. AskQuran ya lissafa nassoshi ne kawai kuma baya bayyana hukunce-hukuncensu anan.
facts.structure.muqattaatNote: AskQuran ya jera tsarin rubutun kawai kuma baya fassara ma'anar waɗannan haruffa.
facts.surahs.search: Nemo surah da suna ko lamba…
facts.topics.title: Maudu'ai masu shiryar da Al-Qur'ani
facts.topics.sub: Maudu'ai na jagoranci na rayuwa sun rataya ne kai tsaye ga ayoyin Alqur'ani. Danna kowace magana don duba Larabci, fassarar, da tafsiri idan akwai.
facts.mentions.title: Alqur'ani ya ambaci
facts.mentions.sub: Annabawa da manyan mutane masu suna a cikin Alqur'ani, tare da nassoshi inda suka bayyana. Ƙididdiga ayoyi ne na faruwar kalmomi daga rubutun Alqur'ani.
facts.mentions.prophetsTitle: Annabawa mai suna a cikin Alqur'ani
facts.mentions.punishmentSub: Mutanen da Al-Qur'ani ya siffanta kamar yadda aka gargade su ko kuma aka azabtar da su, an haɗa su da dalilin da aka bayar a cikin rubutun. An jera a matsayin nassoshi kawai - ba a bayyana hukunce-hukunce a nan ba.
facts.sources.title: Sources
facts.sources.sub: Ana karanta metadata na tsari daga waɗannan kafofin. Alqur'ani, tarjama, da nassin tafsiri koyaushe ana nuna su a zahiri tare da sifa.
facts.structure.sajdahDesc: An jera ayoyin Sajdah daga metadata na Alqur'ani. Bude kowace magana don duba Larabci, fassara, da tafsiri idan akwai.
facts.structure.muqattaatDesc: Wannan sashe ya lissafo surorin da suka fara da harrufa masu rarrabuwa kamar yadda suke a cikin nassin Alqurani. Ba a fassara ma'ana anan.
facts.surahs.sub: Duk surori 114 masu tsarin metadata. Bincika da suna ko lamba, tace ta wurin wahayi, sannan a tsara.
facts.topics.trust: Ana nuna waɗannan batutuwa ne kawai idan ana iya haɗa su kai tsaye da ayoyin Alqur'ani. An keɓe da'awar tafsiri da rahotannin da ake jayayya a cikin Haƙiƙanin Alƙur'ani.
facts.mentions.intro: Sunaye, al'ummomi, nassosi, da wuraren da aka ambata a cikin Alƙur'ani - kowannensu an kafa shi don jagorantar nassoshi na ayah.
facts.mentions.wordForms: Kalma ta fito a cikin rubutu
footer.freeEm: AskQuran kyauta ne, mara talla, kuma koyaushe zai kasance.
footer.freeRest: Ba ya neman taimako. Amsoshinsa sun dogara ne akan Alqurani kawai, ingantattun tafsiri, da tafsiri, ba tare da nassin addini da aka samar ba.
footer.dua: Allah Ya karbi wannan qoqari, Ya sa shi amfane shi, kuma Ya gafarta masa kurakurensa.
footer.src: Rubutun tushe daga Tanzil · Fassara & tafsirin da aka gabatar ba tare da an canza su ba tare da cikakkiyar sifa.
browse.footPrefix: Ba za a iya samun tambayar ku ba?
results.contextExplain: Ayoyin da ke kewaye da su - kadan kafin da bayan - an nuna su tare don haka ana karanta wannan ayar a cikin cikakken mahallinta maimakon a kan kanta.
about.h1: Alqur'ani shiriyar Allah ce ga bil'adama, yana nuna hanya madaidaiciya ta rayuwa tare da imani, adalci, rahama, da hisabi.
about.lede: AskQuran yana taimaka wa mutane su kai ga shiriyar Kur'ani a sarari, kai tsaye, kuma tare da mahallin da ya dace - ba amsa da aka ƙirƙira ba, ko da yaushe rubutun tushe.
about.whyHead: Alqurani shiriya ce ga rayuwar dan adam
about.whyP1: Yana magana da zuciya, iyali, al'umma, kasuwanci, adalci, rahama, hisabi, da alakar mutum da Allah. Tana koya wa mutane yadda za su bauta wa, yadda za su bi da wasu, yadda za su kāre ’yancin iyaye, ma’aurata, ’ya’yansu, ’yan’uwa, marayu, matalauta, da marasa galihu—da kuma yadda za su yi rayuwa da gaskiya, haƙuri, mutunci, da hakki.
about.whyP2: Yana ba da ja-gora sarai a kan al’amura da yawa da mutane suke fuskanta a rayuwarsu ta yau da kullum: gado, aure, saki, dukiya, ciniki, bashi, sadaka, zalunci, gafara, tuba, da halin mutum. Yana ba da labarun annabawa da al'ummomin farko - ba kawai a matsayin tarihi ba, amma a matsayin darussa game da imani, girman kai, zalunci, lalata, ɗabi'a, da sakamakon zaɓin ɗan adam.
about.beliefLead: An gina AskQuran akan wannan imani:
about.beliefHi: ya kamata mutane su iya isa ga shiriyar Alqur'ani a sarari, kai tsaye, tare da mahallin da ya dace.
about.whatP1: Lokacin da wani ya yi tambaya mai alaƙa da rayuwa, AskQuran yana bincika bayanan Alƙur'ani da ke akwai kuma ya dawo da nassoshi na Kur'ani masu dacewa - tare da ayah ta Larabci ta asali, zaɓaɓɓen fassarar, mahallin ayah, da tafsiri a inda akwai.
about.inc1s: Alqur'ani a cikin harshen larabci na asali
about.inc4s: Ayoyin nan da nan gaba da bayansu
about.inc6s: Kowane rubutu an samo shi zuwa asalinsa
about.lineHead: Yana nuna tushen - ba ya magana game da shi
about.does1: Bincika bayanan Al-Qur'ani da aka jera sannan a mayar da nassoshi masu dacewa
about.does2: A kwaikwayi rubutun tushen kai tsaye kuma cikin cikakken mahallin
about.does3: Taimaka wa mutane suyi nazarin ayoyin da suka dace da tsabta
about.does4: Faɗi haka a sarari lokacin da ba a sami madaidaicin tushe mai tushe ba
about.doesNot1: Ƙirƙirar ra'ayoyin addini, fatawoyi, ko tafsirin mutum
about.doesNot3: Canza tafsiri ko tafsiri ta kowace hanya
about.doesNot4: Ƙirƙirar amsa ko shimfiɗa dacewa don cike gibi
about.sensitiveHead: Lakabin jigo shine Layer kewayawa - babu wani abu kuma
about.sensitiveP1: Don batutuwa masu mahimmanci kamar gado, saki, haƙƙoƙin mata, rigingimun iyali, dukiya, ko zamantakewa, AskQuran yana amfani da metadata da aka bita don haɗa tambayoyin gama-gari tare da nassosin Alƙur'ani masu dacewa.
about.noteH3: Waɗannan alamomin hanya ce kawai don kewayawa
about.noteP: Ba nassin Alqur'ani ba ne, ba tafsiri ba, ba hukunce-hukuncen addini ba. Dole ne a sake nazarin su kafin a yi amfani da su a bainar jama'a, kuma a keɓe su a fili daga rubutun tushe a kowane mataki.
about.commitHead: Abubuwa hudu za mu yi kullum
about.pledge1s: An adana tushen ayah daidai kamar yadda aka saukar, ba a taɓa shi ba.
about.pledge2b: Rike fassarori da tafsiri ba su canza ba
about.pledge2s: An gabatar da su kamar yadda marubuta masu suna suka rubuta.
about.pledge3s: Rubutun tushe da lakabin jigo ba sa yin duhu tare.
about.pledge4s: Babu bayyanannen magana? Mukan ce haka, maimakon mikewa.
about.purposeLead: Don taimaka wa mutane su koma ga Alqur'ani a matsayin jagora don zama ingantattun mutane - zama da su

facts.integrity.0.d: Counts, names, revelation place and order are read from established Quran metadata datasets.
facts.integrity.1.t: The Quran Arabic text is unchanged

facts.integrity.2.d: Translated meaning and commentary are displayed apart from the source text, with full attribution.
facts.integrity.3.d: Anything thematic or interpretive must be reviewed by qualified scholars before it is shown publicly.

facts.plants.title: Fruits, Trees and Plants in the Quran
facts.plants.sub: Quran references to named fruits, trees, and plant foods, shown only from direct ayah references.
facts.plants.sourceNote: This list is generated from direct Arabic term matches in the local Tanzil Quran text. It does not add botanical claims or tafsir-based identifications.
facts.plant.datesN: Some references mention the date-palm tree, its fruit, or date-palms in gardens.
facts.plant.olivesN: 24:35 mentions a blessed olive tree in the parable of light.
facts.plant.fruitGeneralN: These references use general fruit wording rather than a specific named fruit.
facts.plant.datePalmTreeN: This overlaps with dates because the Quran mentions date-palms as trees and in fruit/garden contexts.
facts.plant.talhN: Translations differ; some render it as layered banana, others as acacia or a thornless lote-like tree. No single botanical identification is forced.
facts.plant.khamtN: Often translated as bitter fruit/tree. The label is kept cautious.
facts.plant.treeGenericN: These references use general tree wording or specific Quranic tree contexts.
facts.plant.fumN: Translations differ; often rendered garlic, wheat, or grain. The label is kept cautious as “Fum”.
facts.plant.rayhanN: Often translated as basil, fragrant plant, or sweet-scented plant. The label is kept cautious.
